messages.subject: Polaris - position on cap/basket before the call
messages.plaintextBody:
James, Tom,

Before Wednesday's call: I think we land the cap at 22.5% (£7.38m) and hold the basket at a level closer to £350-400k. The escrow is our real protection given the Leeds licence-to-alter and the Pennine change-of-control consent are still open. Tom - can you pull the DD risk list into a one-pager so we can point Castle & Vane at the specific exposures.

Sarah
